quotient_geometry.source: sealed P20 Phase-C BASE census artifacts only
quotient_geometry.interpretation: P20 raw-address blow-up is prospectively compressible under an outcome-blind structural quotient.

development_mediation.interpretation: Bounded positive Q0 mediator fibers were localized for both P19 obstruction families SF/B and B/E, with probed negative fibers in each positive cell.

base_full_class_endpoint.statement: For every frozen carrier cell, FULL_CLASS support equaled BASE support.
base_full_class_endpoint.implication: Every possible paired carrier contrast also has D_class = D_base because neither constituent engine cell changed support.

q0_fiber_branch.defect: g10_p20_forced.setup set C3X_P32_FAMILY=ALL during fresh cataloging, but the inherited P32 event-target surface has no ALL family branch; therefore zero events were catalogued for Q0 targeting.
q0_fiber_branch.effect_on_closure: None. The frozen final adjudication already requires fresh pair-class-effect support before Q0 recovery can be adjudicated. The independently valid BASE/FULL_CLASS arms observed zero class effects, so P21 is HOLD without consulting the invalid fiber branch.
q0_fiber_branch.reason_no_rerun: Re-running fiber removal cannot create the missing parent class effect and would open additional fresh outcomes after the stopping condition is already known.

scientific_conclusion: P21 solves P20's representational blow-up on development worlds: Q0 compresses 8k–32k raw events to 60–138 outcome-blind fibers per cell while satisfying the frozen representation gates.
P21 also localizes bounded development mediator fibers for both P19 obstruction families.
Those development mediator effects cannot receive fresh transport authority because the frozen parent MOVE_ORDER/CUTOFF class interventions produce zero support changes on all 32 fresh carrier cells.
The dominant unresolved object is therefore not finer event localization but context-gated activation of mediator-class susceptibility across engine×world ecologies.
The fresh HOLD does not falsify Q0 as a representation; it withholds transport authority because the causal parent effect is absent.
claim_ceiling: Do not claim fresh Q0 mediator transport.
Do not interpret development Q0 fibers as universal causal kinds.
Do not rerun or resample Phase-E merely to obtain class effects.
Do not repair the invalid fresh fiber catalog and treat a subsequent fiber result as confirmatory within P21.
Do not infer human cognition, objective chess truth, strategy semantics, or Elo-strength ordering.
